wooloo/HerdrTitle.swift ports the popup title layout of ratatui-core 0.1.0 and
ratatui-widgets 0.3.0 (Block titles, Line and Span rendering), the string width of
unicode-width 0.2.2 and the grapheme cluster rules of unicode-segmentation 1.13.3.
wooloo/HerdrTitleTables.swift holds tables generated from those two crates, which are
derived from the Unicode Character Database (Unicode 17).
